notes: Added missing schema/contract and API/error handling stories to complete feature coverage.

GPTR-F-001-S149.title: Allowlist Schema and Contract Definition
GPTR-F-001-S149.description: Define a strict schema and contract for GPTReader requests including allowed collections, permitted query operators, field-level access rules, and maximum limits. Implement as Pydantic models or equivalent validation layer to standardize enforcement inputs.

GPTR-F-001-S150.title: Standardized Enforcement Error Handling
GPTR-F-001-S150.description: Implement consistent error responses for rejected or sanitized requests including explicit rejection reasons, HTTP status codes, and audit-safe messaging that avoids leaking restricted schema details.
